name: Flu from Thursday
description: Win comes down with flu on Thursday morning, brought in by a visitor; Tom rings in sick with it the next day (a staff case: kept off work and logged, but not counted towards the outbreak); Arthur falls ill on Saturday afternoon, the second resident case within 5 days, which declares the outbreak. The Lounge closes and only essential visits go ahead until 5 days after the last resident case's onset, once every resident case is symptom-free.
